answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
单张百分比堆叠柱图：6 个国家 × 4 个分段 = 24 段，左轴刻度 `0%`、`25%`、`50%`、`75%`、`100%`，无网格线。每段内部印白色（灰段为深色）粗体数值，包括 Finland 顶部仅 5 个百分点的窄段。图例在图下方两行四项，与柱段仅靠颜色对应。全大写两行标题 `PROPORTION WHO PAY MOST ATTENTION TO NEWS BRANDS VERSUS JOURNALISTS – SELECTED MARKETS`，无图号；下方注释含题号与逐国样本量 `Base: Finland = 2064, Germany = 2002...`。整图还需与左栏正文并排，共享同一横向版面带。

## 定位一个值难在哪
`21` 在同一图上出现两次：USA 的橙色 `Specific journalists or commentators` 段，以及 France 的青色 `Specific news brands` 段。数值虽已印出、无需读轴，但要唯一定位必须同时拿到国家刻度名与图例名，而图例名只能通过颜色回溯——解析器若只抓到孤立的 “21”，行标签就落不到正确单元格上。

## 不确定的
标题第二行是否算副标题（我按整体换行处理，subtitle 留空）；图内是否有极浅的水平网格线，150 dpi 下看不出；Finland 的 `5` 与 Brazil 的 `7` 标签是否真的溢出窄段，边界难判。

heading.title: PROPORTION WHO PAY MOST ATTENTION TO NEWS BRANDS VERSUS JOURNALISTS – SELECTED MARKETS

axes.serves: all stacked segments in all six bars

worked_example.why_hard: `21` also appears as France's news-brands segment; only country plus legend colour disambiguates it

every bar reaches the `100%` tick; segments per country sum to 100
four legend keys in two rows under the category axis, starting `Specific news brands`
`Q_Journalists_1. When looking for news online... Base: Finland = 2064, Germany = 2002...`
left column body text runs level with the figure in the right column
Finland's top magenta band is 5 points tall and the `5` label nearly fills it

answer.hardest_step_why: 数值都已印出，读数无误差；但 21 在 USA 橙段与 France 青段各出现一次，须靠颜色回溯图例名才能唯一定位。

examples.quote: PROPORTION WHO PAY MOST ATTENTION TO NEWS BRANDS VERSUS JOURNALISTS – SELECTED MARKETS
examples.why: 无图号、全大写两行标题，末尾 “– SELECTED MARKETS” 是范围限定而非单位，标题需拆成多字段。

examples.quote: `5` printed in white inside Finland's top magenta band; y ticks read 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%
examples.why: 标签一律置于段内并在极窄段中挤压，刻度带百分号，当前样式维度无法控制。

examples.quote: figure occupies the right column while body text `But to what extent do people identify...` runs level in the left column
examples.why: 图与正文共享同一横向版面带，整页导出需记录图相对两栏文本的位置。

examples.quote: Q_Journalists_1. ... Base: Finland = 2064, Germany = 2002, UK = 2410, USA = 2036, Brazil = 2022, France = 2059.
examples.why: 注释含题号与逐类别样本量；需要能生成按类别拆分的 base 行，而非单一 source 行。
